oneLine: Promoter sale of shares in Lords Mark Industries.

sources.title: Lords Mark Industries Share Price: Promoter Sale

synopsis: Lords Mark Industries promoter Sachidanand Hariram Upadhyay sold a 4.32 percent stake in the company, amounting to 1.84 crore shares across two tranches for a combined Rs 155.92 crore. The shares were sold at prices ranging between Rs 84 and Rs 84.86 per share. On the buying side, Goldman Sachs Investments Mauritius I acquired 51 lakh shares for Rs 42.84 crore, and Hisaria Group-owned AT Trade Overseas bought 30 lakh shares for Rs 25.2 crore, with both buyers purchasing their allotments at Rs 84 apiece. The transaction was updated on September 21, 2026.
